name: Vilos Ioveanu
source: Vilos comes from a fairly long line of wizards and grew up aware of the paranormal world. It was only natural for him to maintain an involvement in the community and the organizations that regulate magic and the supernatural. Though he never particularly sought to become a care-taker for the younger members of the supernatural community, he eventually found himself working alongside several other teachers and leaders to offer guidance and support for adolescents as they awaken as Cryptics.
